# Data Model: Online Quotient Learning

*Generated by speckit-plan Phase 1 — 2026-05-25*

## Core Entities

### ObservationHistory

A finite sequence of observations produced by an agent interacting with a POMDP.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `observations` | `tuple[int, ...]` | Ordered sequence of discrete observation tokens |
| `length` | `int` | `len(observations)` |

**Invariants**:
- Observations are non-negative integers in `[0, |O|−1]`
- Empty history `()` is valid (represents the root node)

**Relationships**: Many `ObservationHistory` instances map to one `QuotientClass`

---

### QuotientClass

An equivalence class of observation histories that are indistinguishable to the bounded agent.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `class_id` | `int` | Canonical identifier (0-indexed) |
| `representative` | `ObservationHistory` | Canonical history chosen as representative |
| `members` | `set[ObservationHistory]` | All histories in this class (for validation only) |

**Invariants**:
- Two histories in the same class have identical future-observation distributions under all policies
- The set of all classes partitions the set of all finite observation histories
- `class_id` assignment is arbitrary; only partition structure matters for correctness

---

### CanonicalQuotient

The unique minimal quotient — the Myhill-Nerode canonical form for a bounded agent in a POMDP.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `n_classes` | `int` | Number of equivalence classes (the quotient size) |
| `partition` | `dict[ObservationHistory, int]` | Maps each history to its class_id |
| `transition` | `dict[tuple[int, int], int]` | `(class_id, observation) → class_id` (quotient transition function) |

**Invariants**:
- `n_classes` equals the Myhill-Nerode index of the agent's bounded-interaction function
- `transition` is deterministic and total over `[0, n_classes−1] × [0, |O|−1]`
- Minimality: no proper sub-quotient satisfies these constraints

---

### Trajectory

A sampled interaction episode from a POMDP environment.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `observations` | `list[int]` | Observation sequence `[o_0, o_1, ..., o_T]` |
| `actions` | `list[int]` | Action sequence `[a_0, a_1, ..., a_{T-1}]` |
| `rewards` | `list[float]` | Reward sequence `[r_0, r_1, ..., r_{T-1}]` |
| `length` | `int` | Episode length T |
| `seed` | `int` | Random seed used to generate this trajectory |

**Relationships**: Many `Trajectory` objects → `TrajectoryDataset`

---

### TrajectoryDataset

A collection of trajectories used for quotient estimation.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `trajectories` | `list[Trajectory]` | All collected episodes |
| `n_trajectories` | `int` | Dataset size |
| `environment_id` | `str` | Identifier of the source POMDP |
| `policy_id` | `str` | Exploration policy used |

**State transitions**: Immutable once constructed (snapshots for reproducibility)

---

### ContinuationSample

Future-observation samples drawn from a fixed observation history, used by the equivalence test.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `history` | `ObservationHistory` | The conditioning history |
| `continuations` | `list[tuple[int, ...]]` | Sampled future observation sequences |
| `window_length` | `int` | Length k of each continuation window |
| `n_samples` | `int` | Number of samples drawn |

**Relationships**: Derived from `TrajectoryDataset`; input to `EquivalenceTest`

---

### EquivalenceTestResult

The outcome of a statistical test comparing two observation histories.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `history_a` | `ObservationHistory` | First history |
| `history_b` | `ObservationHistory` | Second history |
| `test_statistic` | `float` | Computed test statistic (MMD² or G-statistic) |
| `p_value` | `float` | p-value of the test |
| `same_class` | `bool` | `True` if null hypothesis (same distribution) is not rejected |
| `alpha` | `float` | Significance threshold used |

---

### RCritEstimate

Estimated critical communication rate derived from a pair of learned quotients.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `quotient_a` | `CanonicalQuotient` | Learned quotient for agent A |
| `quotient_b` | `CanonicalQuotient` | Learned quotient for agent B |
| `r_crit` | `float` | Estimated R_crit value (bits per timestep) |
| `true_r_crit` | `float \| None` | Ground-truth R_crit (if known) |
| `relative_error` | `float \| None` | `|r_crit − true_r_crit| / true_r_crit` |

---

## Key Relationships

```
TrajectoryDataset
    ├── [1..*] Trajectory
    │       └── observation prefix → ObservationHistory
    └── extracts → ContinuationSample

ContinuationSample × ContinuationSample
    → EquivalenceTestResult

EquivalenceTestResult[*]
    → (clustering) → CanonicalQuotient

CanonicalQuotient × CanonicalQuotient
    → RCritEstimate
```

## Validation Rules

- `TrajectoryDataset.n_trajectories` ≥ theoretical lower bound for target ε, δ, n_classes (enforced at construction)
- `CanonicalQuotient.n_classes` ≤ ground-truth quotient size on known benchmarks (convergence check)
- `RCritEstimate.relative_error` ≤ 0.10 on benchmark POMDPs (success criterion from spec)
